title: "What's wrong with my resume?" (Here's how to check)
description:
“How can I fix my resume?” is THE most common question we see about resumes and for good reason - a resume is difficult document to nail down. The easiest way to start making fixes to your resume is dial in on the basics. Do you have all your contact information? Do you have every section for an optimized resume? Analysis Mode in the Teal Resume Builder can help you find those things so check it out. #resumetips #resumewriting #resumetemplate #resumebuilder #resumebullets
